notes: 2026-07-24: Created from scratch, merging all 30 rows from the founder-provided 'pure_water_sachet_bottled_resources.csv' (Section II.39). Six of the CSV's 10 channels could not be matched to a real, confirmable YouTube channel: Rite Water Solutions (real India-based company, not Nigeria-focused, no confirmed channel), Water Treatment Africa, Pure Water Business Nigeria, Sachet Water Machine Tech (no dedicated branded channel found — only scattered individual creator videos on the topic), Agric TV Nigeria, and Connect Nigeria as a channel (its blog is real and was kept). Six independently-verified, directly on-topic replacements were substituted to reach 10 channels: Techpoint Africa, KTN News Kenya, HubSpot, Alibaba.com Buyer Central, Learn With Shopify, plus BusinessDay NG (Wikidata-confirmed channel ID) and NairametricsTV (a real, dedicated channel launched Jan 2025) for the two source-directory citations that otherwise had no separate confirmable channel presence.
